descriptions.crossref: DOI registry · ~170M scholarly works, gold standard for metadata
descriptions.openalex: Open metadata graph · ~260M works, free Scopus alternative

descriptions.trdizin: Turkish academic journal index · TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM
descriptions.wos: Clarivate citation index · subscription, peer-reviewed Core Collection
